overview_description.description:
The Box Self Storage Services offer complete protection for your goods both for domestic and commercial purposes. As an added advantage, They offer you the flexibility of accessing the stored items at any time through Their 24-hour access control log. Moreover, They provide insurance for your goods should there be any unexpected damage during calamities.

They provide the best moving and relocation services in Dubai and UAE.  They design a customized relocation plan for you based on your requirements and budget. One of Their  relocation experts will always be around keeping an eye on the loading and unloading process and making sure that your items stay safe and undamaged.

product.name: Personal Storage
product.description: Self-storage units for individuals to store personal belongings with 24/7 access and climate control.

product.name: Business Storage
product.description: Storage units designed for businesses to store equipment, documents, inventory, and marketing materials with flexible contracts.

product.name: Removals and Moving Services
product.description: Professional moving services including packing, loading, transporting, unpacking, and optional handyman assistance for local and international moves.

product.name: Packing Materials
product.description: A retail service offering a variety of packing supplies for customers to purchase for their storage or moving needs.

product.name: International Shipping - AirBox Express
product.description: An expedited international shipping service delivering packages to European destinations within five days, including pricing and packing management.

product.name: 2 Guys & a Truck
product.description: A transport service providing clients with assistance in moving items to and from storage units or other locations using a truck and crew.
